speaker: richard_field
text: Will? Richard Field. From the shop.

speaker: richard_field
text: I have had Millington's little book in my hand. I hear thou sawest it. Short's work; honest presswork on a dishonest copy. Come Sunday and be angry at my table and not in Paul's.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was not angry. I was curious whose it was.

speaker: richard_field
text: The man's who entered it. That's the trade. If thou'dst print thy plays thyself…

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They're not mine to print. They're the company's.

speaker: richard_field
text: Then whose is the complaint? Sunday. And the Holinshed.

speaker: richard_field
text: Sunday, then. Come to the table. God keep you.
